data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'anisos', meaning 'grace, beautiful, unalike'. In Greek mythology, Anissa was a nymph who protected travelers. in_greek.name: Ανίσσα

in_latin.name: Anissa
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Anissa originem habet in lingua Latina et significat 'Gratia Dei' vel 'Amor Dei'. Vox 'gratia' significat 'gratia' vel 'favor', et vox 'Dei' significat 'Deus'. Nomen Anissa exprimit ideam gratiae Dei et est nomen commune inter Christianos.
